en: He is tired; he does not even want to talk.
explain: 甚至 adds a stronger case.

en: It is very cold; it has even started to snow.
explain: 甚至 comes before the stronger case.

prompt: Which sentence says: He even forgot his own name?
options: 他甚至忘了自己的名字。
他忘了甚至自己的名字。
zh: 他甚至忘了自己的名字。
en: He even forgot his own name.
explain: 甚至 comes before the verb.

en: Although he was busy, he still came.
explain: 尽管 gives a fact; 还是 gives the result that did not change.

zh: 尽管很难，我们还是做完了。
en: Although it was hard, we still finished it.
explain: 尽管 + situation, 还是 + result.

zh: 既然你不喜欢，就别买吧。
en: Since you do not like it, do not buy it.
explain: 既然 accepts that the fact is true.

en: Since you want to go, go.
explain: 既然 + known fact, 就 + advice.

zh: 由于太忙，因此他没有时间吃饭。
en: Because he is too busy, he has no time to eat.
explain: 由于 + reason, 因此 + result.

zh: 由于身体不好，因此他不能去。
en: Because his health is bad, he cannot go.

zh: 她看见朋友，于是走了过去。
en: She saw her friend, so she walked over.
explain: 于是 links two actions in order.

zh: 他有点儿渴，于是喝了一杯水。
en: He was a little thirsty, so he drank a glass of water.
explain: 于是 + what he did about it.

zh: 我很累，于是早一点睡觉了。
en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

zh: 我想去，不过今天太累了。
en: I want to go, but I am too tired today.
He is clever, and he works hard too.
explain: 并且 adds a second good thing.

zh: 我喜欢咖啡，而我的朋友喜欢茶。
en: I like coffee, while my friend likes tea.

zh: 我不是不喜欢他，而是不了解他。
en: It is not that I dislike him; I do not know him well.
explain: 而 comes before 是 and gives the true idea.

en: I am not tired; I am hungry.
explain: 不是 + wrong idea, 而是 + true idea.

zh: 首先要吃饭，其次要休息。
en: First you must eat; second you must rest.
explain: 其次 gives the second point.

zh: 他很聪明；此外，他也很努力。
en: He is clever; in addition, he works hard too.
explain: 此外 is the formal "in addition".

zh: 这个城市很大；另外，人也很多。
en: This city is big; besides, it has many people.
explain: 另外 starts the new point.

zh: 我爱吃甜的东西，比如水果和面包。
en: I love sweet things, for example fruit and bread.

zh: 他爱吃甜的东西，例如面包。
en: He loves sweet things, for example bread.
explain: 例如 comes right before the example.

zh: 这个办法很好，同时也很简单。
en: This way is good, and at the same time simple.
explain: 同时 = at the same time.

zh: 她在听音乐，同时在做作业。
en: She is listening to music and doing homework at the same time.
explain: 同时 joins the two actions.

zh: 没有出租车，我们只好走路回家。
en: There are no taxis, so we have to walk home.
explain: 只好 = the only thing left is to.

zh: 车坏了，他不得不走路去。
en: His car has broken down, so he has to walk.
explain: 不得不 comes before the verb.

zh: 快一点走，否则就来不及了。
en: Hurry, or it will be too late.
There is still time if we set off now.
explain: 来得及 = there is still time.

en: Call him right away.
explain: 赶紧 goes before the verb.

en: He quickly ran home.
explain: 赶快 goes before the verb.

zh: 难道他不知道这件事吗？
en: Does he really not know about this?
Have you really forgotten?
He actually went alone.

zh: 我本来不饿，可是看见饭就想吃了。
en: I was not hungry at first, but I want to eat when I see food.
So this is your book.
I have never seen him.
explain: 从来没 means "never up to now".

en: I am not tired at all.
This is not hard at all.
Here it tends to be cold in winter.
explain: 往往 describes what usually happens.

en: Students tend not to like exams.
He drinks a cup of coffee now and then.
He nearly forgot to bring his phone.
I almost fell asleep.
explain: 差点儿 goes before the verb.

en: This book has about two hundred pages.
I must study at least two years.
explain: 至少 goes before the amount.

zh: 这里夏天很热，尤其是八月。
en: It is hot here in summer, especially in August.

zh: 有十个人，其中三个是老师。
en: There are ten people, and three of them are teachers.
explain: 其中 points back to the ten.

en: I guess he will not come.
This question is definitely hard.
Maybe he does not know.
explain: 也许 goes before the verb.

en: Be sure not to tell him.
explain: 千万 gives a strong warning.

en: I cannot answer.
explain: 无法 goes before the verb.

zh: 已经很晚了，他仍然在工作。
en: It is already late, and he is still working.
She still does not know about this.
Please go on speaking.
In the end he found a job.
I will start again from the beginning.
explain: 重新 goes before the verb.

en: How good the weather is here!
How happy the children are!
explain: 多么 comes before the adjective.

zh: 这个菜看起来一般，吃起来倒很好吃。
en: This dish looks ordinary, but it tastes very good.
explain: 倒 = contrary to what you expect.

en: He is busy, but he still came.
I want to go, but he does not want to go.
explain: 却 turns the meaning against the first part.

en: Winter here is even colder.
I am not as clever as my older brother.
They said the same words.

zh: 这两个词的意思不相同。
en: The meanings of these two words are not the same.
For students, this is hard.
He is very serious about studying.
He has passed the exam.

zh: 通过朋友，我找到了工作。
en: Through a friend, I found a job.

zh: 随着天气变冷，雨越来越多。
en: As the weather gets cold, there is more and more rain.

zh: 随着城市变大，路越来越多。
en: As the city grows, there are more and more roads.

zh: 按照地图走，我们找到了银行。
en: Following the map, we found the bank.
As a teacher, she is very serious.

zh: 和他相比，我的汉语不太好。
en: Compared with him, my Chinese is not very good.

zh: 这个电影使我想起了小时候。
en: This film reminds me of my childhood.
This matter makes him very sad.
I have no questions at all.
Eat anything here as you like.
Anyone can help you.
Students from every country have come.
Everything is dear.
He ate all the dishes.
This city has many parks.
I only watched part of it.

zh: 有的人看书，有的人聊天。
en: Some people read and some chat.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … splits the group.

zh: 这些书，有的好，有的不好。
en: Of these books, some are good and some are not.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … compares the parts.

prompt: Which sentence says: Some students are here and some are not?
options: 有的学生在这儿，有的不在。
有的学生在这儿，有的学生不是在。
zh: 有的学生在这儿，有的不在。
en: Some students are here and some are not.
explain: The second 有的 can stand without a noun.

zh: 他以前住在这里，当时他还是学生。
en: He used to live here; at that time he was still a student.
explain: 当时 points back to a time already named.

en: He washes his hands first, then eats.
From then on, he is never late again.
He reads first, then does homework.
explain: 接着 follows the first action.
